jobs.description:
Our client is a key organization within the services sector, known for its strong expertise and continuous focus on innovation and service excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As part of a dynamic and growing organization, you'll take the lead in designing and executing a comprehensive rewards strategy aimed at attracting and retaining top talent, while also ensuring employee satisfaction and engagement across multiple entities.

Key Responsibilities

- In collaboration with external partners and internal HR teams, you'll ensure the seamless execution of payroll processes and employee administrative functions, maintaining accuracy and compliance with relevant laws.
- You'll be responsible for developing and deploying a robust total rewards framework that aligns with organizational goals and attracts, motivates, and retains talent.
- Manage the administration of competitive compensation and benefits programs, ensuring they are aligned with local market practices and legal requirements.
- Guide and support a dedicated HR team, fostering growth and aligning efforts to departmental and organizational objectives.
- Prepare and present regular updates, optimizing current reporting practices to enhance efficiency and quality. You will also be involved in streamlining reporting tools and methods.
- Ensure HR policies are consistently updated and in line with legal standards, providing legal expertise on employment-related matters.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or bring equivalent experience.
- You bring 10+ years of experience in Payroll and Compensation & Benefits, combining both strategic insight and hands-on expertise.
- You have a solid track record in people management, with the ability to lead, coach and develop high-performing teams.
- You possess an in-depth knowledge of Belgian social legislation and Total Rewards frameworks.
- You are fluent in French, Dutch, and English, enabling you to operate effectively in a complex, multilingual environment.
- You are an excellent communicator and presenter, comfortable engaging with a wide range of stakeholders, including C-level executives, employee representatives, and internal teams.
- You thrive in complex and highly regulated environments, navigating challenges with structure, rigor, and adaptability.

jobs.occupation: Sr. Accountant position w/ strategic impact - Zaventem - Legal
jobs.description:
Our client is an international firm that provides legal services across different sectors. They are currently looking for a senior accountant that can work autonomously to support the finance manager.

Jobomschrijving

In this role you will be handling the A-Z accounting tasks, including the following:

• General accounting tasks
• Performing monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings
• Review and control of the balance sheet
• Preparation and filing of the annual accounts (NBB)
• Submission of periodic VAT returns
• Preparation of corporate income tax
• Point of contact for audit matters
• Monthly financial reporting
• Process optimization and automation

We are looking for someone that matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting
• Minimum of 5 years experience in general accounting
• Strong knowledge of BE GAAP
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, good command in English
• Excellent command of Excel
• Analytical mindset
• Team player with good communication skills

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Diegem at the border with Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French and Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

The company is an international player in the chemical industry, focused on producing basic raw materials derived from oil and gas. These materials are used by other companies to manufacture products such as packaging, plastic components, industrial applications, and consumer goods.

Operating on a global scale, the organization combines manufacturing, logistics, and international trade within a highly integrated business model. The work environment is strongly process-driven, with a focus on quality, supply chain excellence, and customer satisfaction.

In addition, the company places a strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, investing in more efficient production processes and the development of increasingly recyclable materials.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description

In this role, you will play a central part in processing and managing customer orders within an international environment. You will ensure smooth administrative handling while monitoring quality, timelines, and communication throughout the entire order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate and manage the complete order process from request to delivery	
• Process sales orders and quotations with a strong focus on accuracy	
• Liaise with internal departments regarding product availability, deliveries, and invoicing	
• Prepare and manage export documentation for international shipments	
• Handle returns and follow up on customer complaints	
• Keep customers informed about order status and deliveries through reporting tools	
• Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, including customers, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams	
• Prepare and distribute reports on order status, deliveries, and critical issues	
• Identify potential bottlenecks within processes and contribute to improvement initiatives	
• Participate in internal meetings and collaborate with various departments

Requirements
	
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience	
• 1 to 3 years of experience in customer service, administration, or order management	
• Experience in an international environment is a strong asset	
• Experience in the shipping industry	
• Experience with shipping documents (Sea Waybill, Bill of Lading,...)	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Teams, Power BI)	
• Knowledge of Incoterms and international payment terms is considered an advantage	
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously	
• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy	
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset	
• Customer-focused with excellent communication skills	
• Team player who thrives in an open and collaborative working environment	
• Able to work independently with a hands-on approach	
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian, Spanish, or any other additional language is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language.
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team

• Hands-on work with real responsibility

• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market

• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow

Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

Do you want to schedule your own day?

Do you want to decide when you take your breaks? 

Do you want to work in a nice and warm environment?

As a Production worker you are responsible for wrapping and packing of several plastic goods. You check the quality and labels the orders. Afterwards you stack everything on the pallet.

• You have experience as a production worker.
• You can work in 3 shifts (morning, afternoon and night)
• You speak and understand English well
• You have your own transportation.

One of your main tasks will be to investigate complaints, deviations, out-of-specifications (OOS) and non-conformities, draft a report on these and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

You will take on a part of the batch release activities of the medicines and other medical products produced on site. Additionally, you will monitor compliance to the internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GMP (flows and zoning included) in production and the laboratory.

More specific: 

• Investigation and drafting of report for deviations; OOS; complaints and non-conformitiesMonitor compliance on internal standard operating procedures (SOP’s) and GMP in production and laboratory area
• Final batch release - including review of batch records (1-2h per day)
• GMP/GDP/Pharmacovigilance training of QC and production operators; warehouse workers and drivers.
• Writing of the yearly PQR (Product Quality Review)
• Review of QC and GMP procedures
• Involvement in GMP validation and qualification activities (equipment and processes in production and laboratory area) and other GMP projects
• Management of CAPA’s related to GMP activities
• Management of change controls related to GMP activities
• Support during (preparation of) audits on site
• Perform internal audits at other sites and suppliers

• You have a master degree in Industrial pharmacy
• You have at least 1 or 3 year experience in a GMP environment.
• You are a teamplayer, dynamic and have very good communication skills.
• Your mothertongue is Dutch and are fluent in English and French

As a 
Quotation Engineer, you will support the commercial process from A to Z. You will work closely with the Sales team and have direct contact with customers to fully understand their technical requirements and expectations. Your ability to analyze information, interpret specifications, and propose suitable solutions will be key to delivering accurate and competitive quotations.
 

Thanks to your analytical mindset and customer-focused approach, you ensure that every proposal is technically sound, commercially attractive, and perfectly aligned with customer expectations. At the same time, you contribute to efficient processes and foster strong collaboration between all stakeholders involved. 
 

Your Responsibilities:
 

As a Quotation Engineer, you will:

• Work closely with the Sales team to prepare quotations, pricing proposals, and technical solutions for our customers. 

• Maintain direct contact with customers to fully understand their needs, technical requirements, and expectations. 

• Analyze customer specifications and translate them into the standard solutions and capabilities offered by RapidFit Plus. 

• Accurately interpret customer expectations and align them with internal technical and operational requirements. 

• Collect and provide all necessary information to ensure accurate cost calculations and the preparation of competitive quotations. 

• Prepare clear, accurate, and customer-focused quotations that meet customer needs and requirements. 

• Ensure proposed solutions are presented transparently and that the scope of services is clearly defined and documented. 

• Collaborate closely with Project Engineers to guarantee a smooth transfer of information during project kick-off and implementation meetings. 

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of sales processes, quotation workflows, and customer collaboration. 

• Ensure timely and accurate processing and maintenance of customer, project, and quotation data within the ERP system. 
 

 

• You hold a degree in Industrial Engineering. 

• Experience in a technical environment such as automotive, machine building, tooling, mold manufacturing, plastics processing, or production engineering is a strong asset.

• You possess strong analytical skills and can easily interpret technical specifications. 

• You communicate effectively with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders. 

• You work in a structured, accurate, and solution-oriented manner. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel. 

• You have an affinity for digitalization and technological innovation. 

• You have an excellent command of English. 

• An interest in AI applications and their potential to improve business processes is considered a valuable asset.

Are you detail-oriented, client-focused, and experienced in KYC and compliance processes? We are looking for a Client Administration Officer to play a key role in managing client files and ensuring compliance within a leading financial services environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established and reputable financial institution specializing in wealth management and investment services. With a strong focus on expertise, long-term relationships, and service excellence, the company offers a collaborative and professional work environment where employees are encouraged to grow and develop their careers.

Description

• Manage the full lifecycle of client files, from onboarding to closure.
• Perform AML/KYC checks and assess client documentation and risk profiles.
• Collect, verify, and maintain accurate client data.
• Ensure compliance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate closely with commercial, legal, and compliance teams.
• Identify and report operational risks when necessary.
• Participate in various departmental and process improvement projects.

• Previous experience in a similar administrative, KYC, compliance, or client support role within the financial services sector.
• Good knowledge of AML, KYC, MiFID, FATCA, CRS, GDPR, or similar regulations.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• A proactive team player with strong communication abilities.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.

As a Personal Assistant in the fashion industry, you will provide comprehensive administrative support to ensure smooth and efficient operations. This role is based in Brussels and requires strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Description

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3+ years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Since its founding in 1891, a culture of continuous innovation has made our client one of the world's leading manufacturers of heavy trucks and buses.

It's unique modular product system, developed over several decades, is one of our key success factors. It is an integral part of our flexible approach and lies at the heart of our business model.

Jobomschrijving

You will independently perform maintenance and repair work on our fleet of vehicles, including trucks and buses.
You'll work with a premium brand, and we’ll turn you into a true specialist in your field!

You’ll join a close team of experienced technicians, all working together toward one goal: providing fast and efficient service to our customers.

We are looking for a passionate mechanic with:
	
• Technical training (A2 or bachelor's degree) in automotive mechanics, electricity, or truck technology.	
•  	
• Knowledge of or experience with heavy vehicles such as trucks, agricultural vehicles, or forklifts.	
•  	
• The ability to work independently.	
•  	
• The motivation to continuously learn through our training programs.	
•  	
• You speak good Dutch or good English.

Company’s activities can be divided into 6 units: BUILDINGS; PARKINGS & TUNNELS, SERVICE & MAINTENANCE; INDUSTRIAL VENTILATION; PARKING GUIDANCE; DAYLIGHT & SUN PROTECTION. 

Their service & maintenance department ensures that all SHEV systems and their possible fire and gas detection, extinguishers, fire hoses, emergency lighting, emergency power generators receive the necessary check-ups after installation and that they can be repaired if necessary.

Jobomschrijving

As a Fitter, you will be responsible for a comprehensive set of tasks:

As a service fitter, you will be tasked with installing smoke exhaust systems and smoke curtains for professional clients in various settings including tunnels, industrial buildings, parking lots, and shopping centers. Your workplace will consistently vary, offering extensive challenges and much variety in your role!

Profile Description
	
• Technical Background: You hold a technical diploma in electromechanics or equivalent through experience.	
• Electrical Knowledge: You possess a solid general knowledge of electricity.	
• Physical Condition: You are physically fit for labor-intensive work and do not have a fear of heights, as the job is primarily on flat roofs, making this an important point.	
• Independent and Team-oriented: You are capable of working independently and enjoy working in a small team.	
• Language Proficiency: You can communicate well in Dutch or French or Englisch. 	
• License: You hold a valid Class B driver’s license.
